暂无连接，点击右上角添加新连接。: No connections yet. Use Add connection at the top right.
界面语言会立即生效，并保存在本机。: Language applies immediately and is saved on this device.
检测到我的账号登录时发送邮件提醒: Send an email when a login to my account is detected
每行一个 IP 或 CIDR，例如 192.168.1.0/24: One IP or CIDR per line, e.g. 192.168.1.0/24
默认隐藏已保存 CAPTCHA 密钥；留空或保持星号不会覆盖已保存密钥。查看时如: Saved CAPTCHA secret is hidden by default. Leave empty or masked to keep the existing secret. Reveal requires a TOTP code if TOTP is on, otherwise your current login password.
图标支持上传常见图片格式，建议使用正方形 PNG/SVG；保存后会同步到页面标题: Upload common image formats; square PNG/SVG recommended. Propagates to page title, favicon, and login page.
开启后根据系统外观自动切换；关闭后使用上面的深色或浅色模式。: When on, switches with system appearance. When off, uses the dark or light mode above.
自定义 CSS/JS 只在选择“自定义”配色时生效；JS 会在登录页、后台和远程: Custom CSS/JS only applies under the Custom scheme. JS runs on the login page, dashboard, and remote windows — only save code you trust.
启用自定义 SSH 终端字体颜色: Enable custom SSH terminal font color
留空时会自动使用深色终端字体的反色，例如白色 → 黑色。: When empty, the inverse of the dark terminal font is used (e.g. white → black).
启用自定义终端背景色（所有配色模式生效）: Enable custom terminal background color (all schemes)
启用自定义选中色（选中背景 + 选中文字，所有配色模式生效）: Enable custom selection color (bg + fg, all schemes)
上传图片最高 12MB；URL 适合使用 CDN/对象存储图片。背景色/选中色与: Images up to 12MB. URLs are good for CDN/object storage. Background/selection colors are independent of the color scheme and override terminal defaults in any mode.
默认 0：最小化后不保留 SSH 连接；-1：不限制；正数：保留最近使用的 N: Default 0: no SSH keepalive for minimized windows. -1: unlimited. Positive N: keep the last N minimized windows connected.
允许终端字体连字（仅同样式 run 内）: Allow terminal font ligatures (same-style runs only)
默认关闭，避免破坏等宽网格；开启后 fi/fl/==&gt; 等可连写，但跨颜色: Off by default to preserve the monospace grid. When on, fi/fl/==> etc. may ligate, but cross-color/style spans will not.
公安备案号，例如：粤公网安备 xxxx号: Public security bureau number, e.g. 粤公网安备 xxxx号
登录页显示备案信息: Show filing info on login page
选择界面显示语言，立即生效并保存到本机。: Choose the interface language. Applies immediately and is saved on this device.
在导航和工作区中显示 AI 功能: Show AI features in navigation and workspace
留空自动使用供应商默认/第一个模型: Leave empty to use provider default / first model
给 AI 助理的全局行为要求，可留空。: Global behavior for the AI assistant; can be empty.
默认 0 = 无上限；如果模型循环调用工具，可设置成 20 / 50 等硬上限。: Default 0 = unlimited. If the model loops, set a hard limit like 20 / 50.
文件编辑器启用 AI 代码补全: Enable AI code completion in file editor
复杂任务优先要求先规划: Require planning first for complex tasks
敏感操作包括远程执行、远程写文件等。关闭确认或开启自动确认会显著提高风险。: Sensitive actions include remote execution and remote file writes. Disabling confirmation or enabling auto-confirm significantly increases risk.
只读自动，写操作询问: Auto for reads, ask for writes
Ask：写操作默认询问: Ask: prompt on writes by default
信任为只读的工具名（逗号分隔，原始 MCP 名）: Trusted read-only tool names (comma-separated, raw MCP names)
允许 AI 看到变量名/说明: Allow AI to see variable name/description
允许 AI 直接看到变量值（仅用于非敏感配置）: Allow AI to see variable value directly (non-sensitive only)
默认完全不向 AI 暴露变量；可单独允许 AI 看到变量名/说明，或仅对非敏感配: Variables are hidden from AI by default. You can allow AI to see the name/description, or expose values for non-sensitive configs only. Hidden values still require get_env_var + confirmation.
说明，例如：调用内部 API 的 Bearer Token: Description, e.g. Bearer token for internal API
Long-term project rules, server conventions, user preferences, troubleshooting notes...
Skill 名称，例如：资深 Linux 运维: Skill name, e.g. Senior Linux ops
Skill instructions: rules, workflow, preferences, tool usage...
Token 用于 Zephyr Agent 主动连接主端并注册文件系统代理。可为: Tokens let Zephyr Agent connect to the hub and register a filesystem proxy. Create multiple tokens for different devices; name, copy, rename, regenerate, or delete them.
默认隐藏已保存 SMTP 密码；留空或保持星号不会覆盖已保存密码。: SMTP password is hidden by default; leave empty or masked to keep the existing password.
给登录用户发送通知: Send notification to the logged-in user
导出文件使用 data/.env 中 ENCRYPTION_KEY 加密；敏感字: Exports are encrypted with the ENCRYPTION_KEY from data/.env. Sensitive fields use ML-KEM-768 + AES-256-GCM hybrid encryption.
关闭后导航栏不显示笔记入口，AI 笔记工具也一并禁用。: When off, the notes entry is hidden from the nav and AI notes tools are disabled.
暂无可见会话。最小化会话可从终端栏恢复。: No visible sessions. Minimized sessions can be restored from the terminal bar.
使用当前表单参数直接连接，不会写入主机库: Connect with the current form parameters without saving to the host library
本次参数不会保存到主机库，直接连接: These parameters will not be saved; connect directly
本次参数不会保存到主机库: These parameters will not be saved
查看已保存连接密码/私钥: Reveal saved connection password / private key
编辑时默认隐藏敏感信息；留空或保持星号不会覆盖已保存凭据。: Sensitive info is hidden by default when editing; leave empty or masked to keep saved credentials.
编辑时默认隐藏已保存密码；留空或保持星号不会覆盖已保存密码。: Saved password is hidden by default when editing; leave empty or masked to keep the saved password.
尝试扩大时间范围查看更早的记录。: Try widening the range to see older records.

请填写片段名称和命令: Snippet name and command are required

删除后无法恢复该条长期记忆。: This long-term memory cannot be restored after deletion.

暂无任务计划。AI 可通过 plan_task 工具为复杂任务创建计划，并持续更: No task plans. AI can create plans for complex tasks via the plan_task tool and keep step status updated.
暂无可用模型供应商。创建自己的 Provider，或让其他用户共享给你。: No model providers available. Create your own provider or have another user share one with you.
暂无 MCP 服务器。配置后由 Go AI Runtime 在每次 run 时连: No MCP servers. Once configured, the Go AI Runtime connects to them on each run.
暂无 AI 环境变量。变量值会加密保存，AI 读取时需要敏感确认。: No AI environment variables. Values are encrypted; AI reads require sensitive confirmation.
暂无长期 Memory。AI 也可通过 memory_save 工具主动记录项目: No long-term memory. AI can also record project memory via the memory_save tool, auto-linked by connection, project, and tag.
暂无 Skill。可以把工作流、工具使用规则、专用提示词保存成能力包。: No skills. Save workflows, tool-usage rules, and dedicated prompts as skill packs.
